verses.en: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write
Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed
Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing
And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character
Soon wilt thou see, and they will see
Which of you is afflicted with madness

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ ضَلَّ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖࣕ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُهۡتَدِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance
So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth)
Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant
Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths
A slanderer, going about with calumnies
(Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin
Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born
Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons

verses.ar: اِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries
Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout

verses.ar: اِنَّا بَلَوۡنٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَا٘ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّةِۚ اِذۡ اَقۡسَمُوۡا لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning
But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will)

verses.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep
So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered)
As the morning broke, they called out, one to another

verses.ar: اَنِ اغۡدُوۡا عَلٰي حَرۡثِكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits
So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)

verses.ar: اَنۡ لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا الۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّسۡكِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day
And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve
But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way
Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)

verses.ar: قَالَ اَوۡسَطُهُمۡ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong
Then they turned, one against another, in reproach
They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed

verses.ar: عَسٰي رَبُّنَا٘ اَنۡ يُّبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهَا٘ اِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا رٰغِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ الۡعَذَابُؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَكۡبَرُۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew

verses.ar: اِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِيۡمِ
verses.en: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord
Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin
What is the matter with you? How judge ye
Or have ye a book through which ye learn
That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَكُمۡ اَيۡمَانٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَالِغَةٌ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِۙ اِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand
Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُۚۛ فَلۡيَاۡتُوۡا بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Or have they some "Partners" (in Allahhead)? Then let them produce their "partners", if they are truthful

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَنۡ سَاقٍ وَّيُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَي السُّجُوۡدِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able

verses.ar: خَاشِعَةً اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٌؕ وَقَدۡ كَانُوۡا يُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَي السُّجُوۡدِ وَهُمۡ سٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused)

verses.ar: فَذَرۡنِيۡ وَمَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُ بِهٰذَا الۡحَدِيۡثِؕ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُمۡ مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not
A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt
Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنۡ كَصَاحِبِ الۡحُوۡتِۘ اِذۡ نَادٰي وَهُوَ مَكۡظُوۡمٌؕ‏
verses.en: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony

verses.ar: لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ تَدٰرَكَهٗ نِعۡمَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ لَنُبِذَ بِالۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُوۡمٌ
verses.en: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace
Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ يَّكَادُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَيُزۡلِقُوۡنَكَ بِاَبۡصَارِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌۘ‏
verses.en: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed
But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds
